subject: Observability add-ons — earn-back credits & tracing packaging
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@sycamore-labs.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@sycamore-labs.com>, Samir Rao <samir.rao@sycamore-labs.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — proposal and ask

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the demo last week. We ran the PoC with the tracing pipeline and the new dashboard widgets — overall team feedback is positive. Before we move to an annual commitment we want to understand the economics for long tail retention and high-cardinality traces.

Specifically:
- We saw a spike in ingestion that would push us into the next retention tier — is there an earn-back/credit path if we put a 12 month commit for base ingestion and commit to a pilot for advanced dashboards?
- Can you clarify per-trace indexing costs vs seat-based dashboard seats?

Budget is tight this quarter but we could expand to Dedicated capacity early next year if we can get an upfront concession that keeps OPEX predictable.

Attached is our rough usage profile and a handful of sample traces. Would appreciate a clear example of a billing outcome (monthly) under two scenarios: conservative ingestion vs spike-inflated ingestion.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Engineering | Sycamore Labs
alex.johnson@sycamore-labs.com | +1 415-555-0137

[Attachment: syc-usage-samples.json (application/json) — stub]
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@sycamore-labs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — proposal and ask

Hi Alex — great to hear the PoC went well. Quick reply with a high level path, and Ill follow up with a worked example spreadsheet.

Short answers:
1) Earn-back credits: yes — we can structure a 12-month slab commit for base retention (ingest + 30d retention) with a quarterly earn-back calculation. If Sycamore exceeds the baseline, we apply a drawdown from a pre-funded credits pool, and unconsumed credits roll forward one quarter. We typically gate this behind a 12-month minimum commit to prevent arbitrage.

2) Tracing vs seats: tracing indexing is metered (per indexed trace) — advanced dashboards are seat-licensed or can be swapped to a project seat model for large orgs. For you I recommend a hybrid: 6 seats for product teams + project seats for SRE on the high-cardinality queries.

Ben and Naomi — looping you in to propose a specific credit structure (numbers) and a pilot SOW. Alex, Ill send a worked example by EOD.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — pricing sketch for Sycamore

Hannah / Naomi — draft numbers below (keeps it conservative but gives Sycamore a clear earn-back):

Proposal sketch (for discussion):
- Base commit: $120k ARR for 12 months covering up to X TB/month ingest with 30d retention.
- Earn-back credits pool: $18k (applied quarterly) — if monthly ingest drops below baseline we refund as credits applied to future months; if above baseline we draw from pool until exhausted.
- Tracing indexing: $0.007 per indexed span (first 100M spans tiered down to $0.004 above 500M).
- Advanced dashboards: 6 seats @ $250/mo + 3 project seats @ $600/mo (pilot discount first 3 months).
- Pilot SOW: 8 weeks (enabled dashboards + two alert recipes + two export connectors) — deliverable: dashboard pack + runbook. SOW attached as PDF stub.

Customer asks we should cover in contract: overage smoothing (30 day lookback), early termination carveouts for platform outage > 72h, and data residency notes.

Naomi — please review for discount flexibility (we can move some credit $ from up-front commit into usage rebates if procurement pushes capex vs opex).

-Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Commercial Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference.com
[Attachment: Sycamore_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf) — stub]
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — pricing sketch for Sycamore

Thanks Ben — two small edits to preserve margin and keep negotiation optional:
1) Make the quarterly earn-back pool fixed in dollars (18k) but allow one-time re-up at quarter boundary if usage is consistently >120% for two consecutive quarters. This avoids permanent unlimited credit liability.
2) Keep trace per-span tiers but add a hard cap to per-month billable spans for the first 6 months (protects Sycamore from accidental spikes). We'll waive the cap if they move to Dedicated.

If legal asks we can put a 45 day review on the SLA carveouts and handle early-termination fees at 25% of remaining commit.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com

Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — earn-back credits & tracing packaging

Hannah / team — this looks workable. Two clarifications before procurement signs:

1) Can you produce the month-by-month worked example for a conservative and a spike scenario (as Hannah promised)? We need to show CFO the worst-case cashflow and the expected nominal case.
2) For the pilot SOW: we like the 8 week plan. Would it be possible to shift two of the dashboard seats to a short-term project seat pool (6 weeks) so we can get product folks access rapidly and keep SRE seats for the last phase?

If you can send the worked example and updated SOW (with the seat timing change) well aim to get legal/procurement ready to sign within two weeks.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Engineering | Sycamore Labs
